The sheet is silent on the coat. g11: Vexxith door, containers, gear and acid air ship parts no scene exercises. Advisory findings g5,g6,g10,g12,g13,g14 are preserved and impose no additional passing bar. Apply the experience rule to mixed demands, retaining existing owner-ruled behavior.
